'''The Kindest Cut''' was a hair salon on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[New Balosar]]. [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Zenn Bien]] worked here, where she was questioned by [[Tobb Jadak]] and [[Flitcher Poste]] about the history of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
